atmosphere.label: Atmospheric OPD
atmosphere.encoding: 8-bit indexed PNG; palette index = display code 0..254; index 255 = pupil exterior (transparent)
atmosphere.piston: the pupil mean (piston) of each displayed map is removed for display only; the removed value per displayed frame is display_piston_nm. A Shack-Hartmann sensor does not sense piston, piston does not change the image, and every RMS on this site is piston-removed. Raw maps keep their piston in the archives.

limitations: Single-realization synthetic SCAO demonstration (one seed, 1000 frames = 1.000 s); no ensemble uncertainty is shown.
Science samples are frame-start snapshots; averages are equal-weight means of sampled instantaneous images.
Recorded nodes only: no interpolation between cases and no unlisted parameter combination.
The uncorrected image is a zero-DM optical counterfactual of the same recorded atmosphere, not a separate sensor/control trajectory.
